query: SELECT s.id FROM dictation_sessions s WHERE s.tenant_id = $1 AND s.created_at < now() - make_interval(hours => $2) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dictation_audio a WHERE a.session_id = s.id) OR (s.status <> 'saved' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dictation_content c WHERE c.session_id = s.id)) OR s.status IN ('processing', 'drafted', 'stt_failed', 'llm_failed', 'no_speech')) ORDER BY s.created_at LIMIT $3
